Kimberly / Marcus — forwarding early SRE notes. I pulled token-level counters and the service policy diff for the rollout that happened at 08:30 PST.

Summary of what I see:
- At 08:30 we rolled a change to the tenant-level burst policy window for Connexx (window moved from 1m -> 15s for the token bucket).
- At ~08:50 traffic pattern shifted (more concurrent short requests) which caused the new window to exhaust quickly, triggering enforcement. Enforcement path returns 502 for some internal error-handling routings we have during quota rejects.
- The error spikes line up with the policy change and the growth campaign window.

Attachments: policy_diff_20261114.json (shows new window value), connexx_error_log_20261114.txt

Recommendation: roll back the burst window to 1m immediately and apply a short-term committed capacity increase (or manual override) while we tune token bucket parameters.

—Monica
Monica Patel
SRE — Inference Platform

Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 10:12:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Connexx — production traces & initial findings

All — confirmed the timing. Root cause appears to be an operator error: the new safety profile intended for canary tenants was applied to Connexx's production policy. The config pushed a 15s burst window into the tenant policy.

Impact: during synchronous short requests, the token bucket refilled too slowly relative to request bursts; the system hit the safety valve which caused an upstream handler to surface 502s instead of graceful 429s (we have an obscure fallback path).

Immediate mitigations implemented (10:18 PST):
- Rolled back tenant burst window to previous 1m value (policy rollback confirmed).
- Opened a manual quota override for Connexx (3x for 90 minutes).
- Added a short-term rule to surface 429s instead of 502s where applicable; ops will continue to monitor.

Next steps: postmortem and control-plane check to ensure canary configs don't leak to prod. Need exec awareness because customer experienced conversion loss.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Technical Account Lead

Telemetry highlights:
- Peak 502 rate: 8.1% at 08:54 PST
- Median tail latency increased from 120ms -> 620ms during peak window
- Estimated impacted sessions: ~12.4k (Connexx supplied IDs); conversion loss estimate pending from customer.

Proposed remediation steps:
- Offer a usage credit for the impacted window (propose 30% of billed usage for the 30-minute window) and expedited engineering fixes for rollout gating.
- Emergency postmortem to be scheduled Mon morning with SRE, Control Plane, and Customer Success.
- Blocklist the canary-to-prod rollout path until additional guardrails are in place.

Can you approve the credit proposal above so we can communicate to Connexx?
